{{Quote|My name is Trevagg&mdash;Feltipern Trevagg, officer of the Empire. I work for the city prefect of Mos Eisley. It is my responsibility&mdash;no duty&mdash;to collect taxes and imposts from those who live and pass through this miserable space port.|Feltipern Trevagg|audio=FeltipernTrevaggIntro.flac|<ref name="Lovers">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
'''Feltipern Trevagg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] tax collector in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] district, a local [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on the side, mainly taking in small petty criminals for either the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] or for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and a co-worker of [[Predne Balu]]. Lover of [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]], nicknamed [[Nightlily]], he would be killed by her as part of a mating ritual.

Feltipern had been through a lot of careers during his life- [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bodyguard, officer of space security, and tax collector.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I saw them together in the cantina, but I didn't think Trevagg was crazy enough to try to bed the girl.|Wuher|audio=FeltipernTrevaggBedTheGirl.flac|<ref name="Lovers" />}}
Feltipern Trevagg was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who tracked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Trevagg never found Kenobi and never left the planet. He then became a corrupt [[Tax collector/Legends|tax collector]] for the [[Imperial Prefect]] of the<ref name="CSWE" /> Tatooine [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]<ref name="Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref> [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="CSWE" /> He was disappointed with his job, though would go through with the job for the sake of earning [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He had sometimes considered going back to Imperial employment. He began sensing a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|strange vibration]] through his extra-sensory cones, and started to think that capturing the source of the vibration would lead to riches.<ref name="Lovers" />

[[File:Drinkup.png|thumb|left|230px|Trevagg buys M'iiyoom Onith another drink.]]
After dealing with a [[Modbrek]] widow who failed to pay taxes for her water lines, Trevagg would invest into the [[Pylokam's Health Food]] booth in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in secrecy. This was part of a plot to capture the origin of the strange vibrations, which he came to the conclusion was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].<ref name="Lovers" />

For the following two weeks, he continued searching for the Jedi. It was during this time that he met [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]], a [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] stranded in Mos Eisley. He instantly fell in love with her and desired to bed her. Her arrival temporarily distracted Trevagg from his search for the Jedi, and he would assist her during her stay on Tatooine. As the two fell more deeply in love, the two dined at the [[Court of the Fountain/Legends|Court of the Fountain]], considered to be one of the classiest restaurants in Mos Eisley. His partner, [[Predne Balu]] continuously warned him to stay away from the girl, but Trevagg ignored his pleas.<ref name="Lovers" />

Trevagg and Onith would later be present in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arranged a flight to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Lovers" /><ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> He contacted Imperial soldiers and requested them to intercept Kenobi at [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]], and even put a bounty on Balu's head to avoid any competition for the reward. Now, finally accomplishing his mission to hunt down Kenobi, Trevagg and Onith rented a room in the [[Mos Eisley Inn]], where the two finally had relations with each other.<ref name="Lovers" />

What Trevagg had never seen coming was the [[H'nemthe mating ritual]] which required Onith to eviscerate him with her razor-sharp tongue when it was over. His body would later be examined by [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], who explained to Balu that a "[[M'iiyoom]]" was a carnivorous plant that killed anything that tried to take its [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]].<ref name="Lovers" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It amuses me no end to sense the flurry of activity that precedes me as I stroll through the marketplace on my way to the office.|Feltipern Trevagg|audio=FeltipernTrevaggAmused.flac|<ref name="Lovers" />}}
Feltipern thought of most other races inferior to Gotals, and thought any being without [[cones]] looked silly and ineffectual. This was due to his home planet, [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]], where beings with small or undeveloped cones would be teased. He could never look at [[Human/Legends|Humans]] without feeling contempt and amused. He was disgusted by the thought of relations between Humans, as Humans were "wan, flabby, and squishy" and that they "lacked both the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] ability to transmit emotional waves and that strength was so necessary to pleasure".<ref name="Lovers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Initially appearing as a background character in the cantina scene of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], portrayed by [[Penny McCarthy]],<ref name="Tom Spina Confirmation">{{DMCite|dm=File:TrevaggAndOnith.png|creator=[[Tom Spina]]|date=2021-08-31}}</ref> Trevagg's character was fleshed out in the ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'' short story ''[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale]]''. In its audio dramatization, Feltipern Trevagg is voiced by [[Alan Oppenheimer]].
